subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fragile
solution:
The correct answer is: **Brittle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fragile"** means something that is easily broken or damaged; it refers to objects that must be handled with care to avoid breaking. (नाजुक)

 
 
• **Example: **The antique vase is very fragile and needs to be handled gently.
 
 

 
• **"Brittle" **refers to a material or object that is hard but liable to break or shatter easily; it is another term that emphasizes the ease with which something can break. (भुरभुरा)

 
 
• **Example: **Dry, brittle leaves crunched underfoot as we walked through the forest.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym for **'Fragile'** is **'Brittle'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Brittle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sturdy **(मजबूत): Strong and firm; not easily broken or damaged.

 
 
• **Example:** The old oak tree is sturdy and has withstood many storms.
 
 

 
• **Unkempt **(अस्त-व्यस्त ): Not combed; untidy; not properly maintained; disheveled.

 
 
• **Example: **He appeared at the door looking unkempt and tired.
 
 

 
• **Intense** (तीव्र): Of extreme force, degree, or strength.

 
 
• **Example:** The athlete underwent intense training for the upcoming championship.
